## Key Production Projects
1. Autonomous WhatsApp AI Agent for Blogging:
   - Full lifecycle blog drafting, updating, publishing, and deletion to Google Blogger entirely via WhatsApp chat messages.
   - Built with n8n, Python, WhatsApp Cloud API webhooks, and Google Blogger REST APIs.
2. Fake News Detection & Fact-Checking System:
   - 92.4% accuracy machine learning platform analyzing news claims using TF-IDF, XGBoost classifier, and Google Gemini AI contextual cross-verification.
   - Built with Python, Django, Django REST Framework, and Bootstrap.
3. KSecure – Dark Patterns Recognition Chrome Extension:
   - Real-time sub-50ms DOM parsing extension detecting deceptive e-commerce UI patterns (fake scarcity, hidden costs).
   - Built with JavaScript Manifest v3 and Flask Bernoulli Naive Bayes classifier.
4. Optimiseres – eCommerce Platform & MCP Automation:
   - Corporate marketing and service portal with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for Walmart Seller Central and advertising automation.
   - Built with Python, Flask, JavaScript, and Vercel GitHub CI/CD.
